verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim the ability to 'scale knowledge and keep teams consistent by creating a shared source of truth that includes context from your docs and repositories,' directly matching the story, and related enterprise-governance features (control planes, audit logs, MCP allow-lists) support team-wide consistency. However, this is a single vendor-claimed line item with no elaboration on setup, structure, or how it functions as a 'workspace,' and no independent/hands-on evidence corroborates it. Missing for 10: independent verification, concrete workflow/UI details, and community confirmation that teams actually use this as a shared source of truth.
